Class InventoryPage

java.lang.Object
GUI.manager.InventoryPage
public class InventoryPage extends Object
Manager page to view, search, add, edit, and delete the supplies in the inventory. A table shows each supply with its unit, a level bar, the last count date, and the unit cost. A supply that a recipe or a restock order uses cannot be deleted, so the manager can archive it.
Author:
Aisha

  • Method Details

    • buildContent

      public javafx.scene.Node buildContent()
      Loads the inventory from the database and builds the page. The search field filters by item or unit, and each column header sorts the table. Archived items always stay at the bottom.
      Returns:
      the page content, to place next to the side menu

    • showAddSupplyDialog

      public static String showAddSupplyDialog()
      Opens the Add Inventory Item dialog for other pages, e.g. the ingredients of a new menu item. The new supply is saved to the database when the manager clicks Add.
      Returns:
      the name of the new supply, or null if the manager cancels
